## Change summary
Describe the component and change.

## Checklist
- [ ] Feature branch follows `feature/<component>/<ticket>`
- [ ] No real secrets or employer/private project code
- [ ] Relevant .NET tests run locally
- [ ] CI checks pass
- [ ] Deployment / rollback impact considered
- [ ] Reviewer approval obtained (when branch rules require it)

## Validation
Include commands run, screenshots or test evidence, and rollout notes.
